reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown read Jesus's ban on oaths as targeting flippant, everyday swearing, not the solemn covenant oath by God's name that the Torah commands.

discrepancy.note: Remsburg juxtaposes God's command to swear by his name with Christ's flat ban on oaths as an unreconciled scriptural contrast.

quotes.text: What is taught respecting the use of oaths? God: “Swear by my name” ( Jeremiah xii, 16 ). Christ: “Swear not at all” ( Matthew v, 34 ).
quotes.attr: John E. Remsburg (d. 1919), The Christ: A Critical Review and Analysis of the Evidences of His Existence (1909), §543, on Jeremiah 12:16 and Matthew 5:34.

sides.snippet: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and him shall you serve, and shall swear by his name.
sides.verseText: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and him shall you serve, and shall swear by his name.
